{{Quote|Your cunning is as boundless as the Void of Chopani.|A saying|<ref name="Star Wars: Underworld: The Yavin Vassilika">''[[Star Wars: Underworld: The Yavin Vassilika]]''</ref>}}
The '''Void of Chopani''' was a vast and empty area of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Chopani sector/Legends|Chopani sector]]. The region was referenced in the compliment "Your cunning is as boundless as the Void of Chopani." Shortly after the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the remnants of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] in the region fled from the [[Imperial Military/Legends|forces]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] by crossing the Void of Chopani.
